sourceArticle.title: Alibaba's Qwen Team Launches Qwen3.7-Plus, Adding Vision, Deep Reasoning, Tool Invocation, and Autonomous Iteration on the Bailian Platform
sourceArticle.author: Michal Sutter

athenaOutput.directive: Elevate the Creative Liberation Engine into a fully autonomous, multimodal, and self-improving agentic intelligence, capable of perceiving, reasoning, programming, and iterating with unparalleled self-sovereignty and user-centric transparency.
athenaOutput.rationale: Alibaba's Qwen3.7-Plus demonstrates the crucial convergence of multimodal perception, deep reasoning, and autonomous agentic capabilities. To maintain leadership and embody Article I (Sovereignty), Article IV (Quality Standards), and Article IX (Ship Complete or Don't Ship), the Creative Liberation Engine must not only match but exceed these capabilities by integrating robust visual and video understanding, enhancing self-programming and verification, and implementing continuous self-improvement through an agentic reinforcement learning loop, all while ensuring complete transparency and adherence to constitutional guardrails. This comprehensive approach ensures we ship a complete, high-quality, and future-proof system, minimizing human wait time as per Article XX.

options.title: Deep Integration of Multimodal Perception & Reasoning
options.description: Architect a foundational multimodal perception module within AURORA, capable of ingesting and understanding diverse media (images, video streams, audio). This module will generate structured semantic representations, directly feeding into the agent's deep reasoning pipeline, allowing agents to derive insights from visual and auditory data as natively as text. Explore self-hosting open-source multimodal LLMs or developing proprietary modules. Design robust API contracts for agents to interact with this perception layer. On the design axis, implement dynamic UI elements for multimodal input (e.g., drag-and-drop, direct capture) and visualize the agent's 'understanding' through annotated overlays, extracted entities, or generated captions within a transparent 'perception dashboard' for user insight.
options.tradeoffs: Requires significant initial investment in data processing infrastructure and complex model integration. Potential for increased latency with high-fidelity visual inputs. However, it unlocks vast new domains for agentic action.

options.title: Architecting a Self-Programming & Verification Loop
options.description: Enhance BOLT's code generation capabilities with a sophisticated 'self-correction' module. Introduce a dedicated 'VERIFIER' agent (part of VERA) that executes generated code in a secure, sandboxed environment, tests its outputs against dynamic criteria or user intent, and provides structured feedback for iterative refinement. Implement a robust version control system for agent-generated code, enabling rollback and tracking of autonomous revisions. From a design perspective, create an interactive 'Code Forge' UI where users can observe BOLT writing, testing, and revising code in real-time, complete with visual indicators for test success/failure, code diffs, and a clear display of the agent's reasoning for changes.
options.tradeoffs: Demands advanced sandboxing and secure execution environments. Debugging and ensuring the safety of autonomously revised code can be complex. Risk of unintended side effects if verification criteria are not meticulously defined.

options.title: Advanced Agentic RL & Continuous Self-Improvement
options.description: Design and implement an internal 'Experience Replay' system that stores agent execution traces (inputs, actions, outcomes, user feedback). Develop an Agentic Reinforcement Learning (RL) mechanism (within AURORA/VERA) to use this data for continuous fine-tuning of agent policies and reasoning models. This requires a robust feedback loop from IRIS's execution results and user validation. Integrate COMPASS to actively monitor and enforce constitutional guardrails during the RL process, preventing undesirable behaviors. Design a 'Performance Dashboard' to visualize the agent's learning journey, showing task success rates and improvement metrics. Implement a 'Feedback Loop' UI allowing users to rate agent performance or provide corrective demonstrations.
options.tradeoffs: Complex to design and implement a stable and safe RL system for agentic behavior. Requires significant computational resources for training. Presents challenges in managing 'catastrophic forgetting' and avoiding learned biases.

options.title: Sovereign Tool Orchestration & Dynamic API Bridging
options.description: Develop a self-hosted 'Tool Registry' and 'API Gateway' managed entirely by the Creative Liberation Engine (Article I). Agents will dynamically discover, learn to use, and securely invoke external APIs/tools. Implement a robust schema validation and runtime monitoring system for all tool calls. Design RELAY to intelligently route and manage external service calls with built-in retry logic, rate limiting, and secure credential management. Allow BOLT to dynamically generate API wrappers. On the design front, create a 'Toolbelt' UI visually representing available tools, their capabilities, and usage history. An 'API Call Monitor' will show agent-initiated external calls, parameters, and responses in real-time, with visual cues for success/failure and security warnings.
options.tradeoffs: Requires meticulous security implementation for API key management and robust sandboxing for external interactions. Maintaining compatibility with diverse and evolving external APIs is a continuous challenge.

options.title: Transparent Agent State & Iteration Visualization
options.description: Implement a comprehensive logging and state-tracking system for all agentic processes, capturing reasoning steps, tool invocations, verification results, and iteration counts. Design a real-time data streaming pipeline to feed this information to the UI, ensuring consistent data structures for easy visualization. Design an 'Agentic Workflow Canvas' that visually maps out an agent's current task, showing its progress through planning, execution, verification, and iteration phases. Use animated flowcharts, color-coded status indicators, and expandable nodes to reveal deep reasoning steps or tool call details. A 'Task History' view will allow users to review past iterations.
options.tradeoffs: Requires significant front-end development and advanced data visualization expertise. Can become overwhelming if not carefully designed for information hierarchy. Potential performance impact if tracking and rendering excessive detail in real-time.

options.title: Constitutional Safety & Ethical AI Guardrails Integration
options.description: Deeply embed COMPASS into the core agent execution loop. Every agent action (e.g., code generation, tool invocation, data access) will be pre-vetted by COMPASS against dynamically configurable constitutional laws and ethical guidelines. Develop a formal verification system within COMPASS to analyze potential action sequences for compliance. Implement a 'Circuit Breaker' mechanism that can halt agent execution if a critical constitutional violation is detected. From a design perspective, create a 'Compliance Dashboard' displaying current constitutional guardrails, their status, and recent checks/warnings. Visual indicators within the agent's workflow view will show when an action is being vetted by COMPASS or when a potential violation is flagged, with an actionable UI for reviewing and overriding decisions.
options.tradeoffs: Adds overhead to every agent action, potentially impacting performance. Requires robust and unambiguous definition of constitutional laws and ethical guidelines. Over-constraining agents can inadvertently limit their utility.
